facts.fact: 1846年夏天，两个聪明却愚蠢的年轻人找上 Scrooge，打赌要去住伦敦最闹鬼的旅馆房间
两人接下赌约：要在伦敦最闹鬼的旅馆房里过一夜
facts.anchor: had accepted a wager to spend a night in the most haunted hotel room in London

facts.fact: 但两人要求 Scrooge 陪在身边
facts.anchor: but wanted Ebenezer by their side

facts.fact: 上尉随后讲 Clerkenwell 一条街上发生的一连串事件，1846 次年秋天
facts.anchor: a sequence of events which had taken place in a street in Clerkenwell

facts.fact: 一个戴兜帽的幽灵似乎挨家挨户飘过
facts.anchor: a hooded spectre seemed to have passed from house to house

facts.fact: 原来那地址上曾有一座修道院，鬼是那个修士
facts.anchor: a monastery had once sprawled upon the selfsame site

facts.fact: 作者以“活在十九世纪而非中世纪”说服修士离开
facts.anchor: he moved now through the pent-up halls of the nineteenth century and not those of the Dark Ages

facts.fact: 双方再次感叹 Ebenezer 还没到 Starningham 实在可惜
facts.anchor: a decided pity it was that Ebenezer had yet to arrive in Starningham

facts.fact: 两人心里其实很享受这段相处，但谁也不肯承认
facts.anchor: though no doubt neither would have cared to admit it either aloud or to themselves

facts.fact: 上尉离开房间前狠狠咽了一下，脚步带着细微不安
facts.anchor: he swallowed hard before he left the room

facts.fact: 他在门厅停下听，等屋子的欢迎或警告，没有等到
facts.anchor: thinking that the house might make some sound of welcome or warning

facts.fact: Susan 说不想敲门，因为……（省略号后是她不肯直说的原因）
facts.anchor: I didn’t want to knock, sir, because

facts.fact: Susan 讽刺上尉刚才回避了“你到底怎么了”这个问题
facts.anchor: Very clever, sir, and very wise, to avoid the asking of a question like that

facts.fact: 上尉把 Susan 带进起居室，Fell 太太正等着
facts.anchor: Captain Ambrose led her through to the drawing room, where Mrs Fell was waiting

facts.fact: 全文最后一句：五分钟后这个夜晚将变成噩梦
facts.anchor: Five minutes later, the evening would turn into a nightmare
